items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: he got his break with Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Last hired and the first fired.

Last hired and first fired; I, I meant -- that's what I meant. Anyway, I, -- at that time I couldn't -- I made a nice living all right because I was doin' pretty good, and, until, until a, Hampton closed his -- he got his break with Benny Goodman. And once more I roamed the

streets of Los Angeles, and pretty soon my money -- I got little property at home on the reservation, and money came, and I cut out. And I said well here I come New York. And I got as far as the reservation in -- south of Phoenix, back to Pima land, and I gave all my money to my mother, and I got stranded there.
